newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.
newsitem.headline: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping soybeans and soy products:

Vessels: Goynuk loading 54,035 tonnes soybeans. Vick Luk loading 33,000 tonnes soymeal. Allegra loading 9,000 tonnes soyoil. Waiting to dock, four vessels to load soybeans, one for soymeal and one for mixed cargo.
Road: 483 trucks carrying soybeans arrived on June 26, as well as 310 trucks with soymeal and 119 trucks with vegetable oils including soyoil.
Vessels: At public terminal, Powhatan loading 57,000 tonnes soymeal. Waiting to dock, two vessels to load soybeans. At Cargill private terminal, Finix loading 40,000 tonnes soymeal.
Waiting to dock, one vessel to load soymeal.
Road: Six trucks carrying 165 tonnes soybeans arrived on June 26 as well as five trucks with 127 tonnes soymeal.
